grades.quote: When a trap is taken into S-mode, `sepc` is written with the virtual address of the instruction that was interrupted or that encountered the exception.
grades.reason: Directly states the value saved in sepc when a supervisor trap is taken.

grades.quote: If `stval` is written with a nonzero value when an instruction access-fault or page-fault exception occurs on a system with variable-length instructions, then `stval` will contain the virtual address of the portion of the instruction that caused the fault, while `sepc` will point to the beginning of the instruction.
grades.reason: Explains sepc's saved address for specific instruction faults, but not supervisor traps generally.
